entries.title: Job 41:1
segments: Can you draw out the leviathan with a hook, or hold down his tongue with a cord?

entries.title: Job 41:2
segments: Can you put a reed rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw with a thorn?

entries.title: Job 41:3
segments: Will he multiply pleas for help to you? Will he speak soft words to you?

entries.title: Job 41:4
segments: Will he make a covenant with you? Will you take him for a servant for ever?

entries.title: Job 41:5
segments: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your maidens?

entries.title: Job 41:6
segments: Shall [your] companions bargain over him? Shall they divide him among the merchants?

entries.title: Job 41:7
segments: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fishing spears?

entries.title: Job 41:8
segments: Lay your hand on him, think of the battle; you will never do it again.

entries.title: Job 41:9
segments: Behold, his hope has been made false; will not one be cast down at the sight of him?

entries.title: Job 41:10
segments: None [is so] fierce as to dare to stir him up; who then [is] able to stand before Me?

entries.title: Job 41:11
segments: Who has gone before Me that I should repay? All that [is] the heavens is Mine.

entries.title: Job 41:12
segments: I will not keep silent [concerning] his limbs, or [his] mighty strength, or the grace of his frame.

entries.title: Job 41:13
segments: Who can take off the surface of his skin; who can come [to him] with his double bridle?

entries.title: Job 41:14
segments: Who can open the doors to his face? Terror [is] round about his teeth.

entries.title: Job 41:15
segments: The rows of shields [are] his pride, shut up with a close seal;

entries.title: Job 41:16
segments: one is so near to another that no air can come between them;

entries.title: Job 41:17
segments: they are joined one to another, they clasp each other so that they can not be separated.

entries.title: Job 41:18
segments: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes [are] like the eyelids of the dawn.

entries.title: Job 41:19
segments: Out of his mouth go burning torches, sparks of fire leap out.

entries.title: Job 41:20
segments: Out of his nostrils goes smoke, as [out] of a boiling pot [fired] by reeds.

entries.title: Job 41:21
segments: His breath kindles coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.

entries.title: Job 41:22
segments: In his neck remains strength, and terror dances before him.

entries.title: Job 41:23
segments: The folds of his flesh are joined together, cast firm on him; he cannot be moved.

entries.title: Job 41:24
segments: His heart is cast hard as a stone, even cast hard as a piece of a riding millstone.

entries.title: Job 41:25
segments: The mighty are afraid from his rising; they are beside themselves from the crashing.

entries.title: Job 41:26
segments: The sword overtakes him, [but] will not hold firm. The spear, the dart, and the javelin [also].

entries.title: Job 41:27
segments: He counts iron as straw, bronze as rotten wood.

entries.title: Job 41:28
segments: An arrow cannot make him flee; slingstones are turned by him into stubble.

entries.title: Job 41:29
segments: Darts are counted as straw; he laughs at the shaking of a javelin.

entries.title: Job 41:30
segments: Points of potsherds [are] under him; he spreads sharp pointed [marks] on the mire.

entries.title: Job 41:31
segments: He makes the deep boil like a pot; he makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

entries.title: Job 41:32
segments: He makes a path to shine after him; one would think the deep [to be] gray-headed.

entries.title: Job 41:33
segments: On earth there is nothing like him, one made without fear.

entries.title: Job 41:34
segments: He beholds all high [things]; he [is] a king over all the sons of pride.
